reason: A fix changed behaviour that a spec record describes, and the agent recorded it as a dated, ticketed amendment bullet on that record instead of rewriting the original sentence. The same format is used across specifications/ (01-map.md, 04-chassis-modules.md), so it should be a skill agents load when touching specs.
The episode added a new spec record for a built feature; the skill only covers amending existing records, so a future session would not know the new-record form or where it goes.

Contradiction in the library: this skill tells an agent to append an amendment straight into specifications/, while metaform-development says a ticket worker never edits a spec record and drafts under artifacts/specs-draft/ until the owner approves the exact wording. The stricter, ticket-specific gate should govern worker agents; this patch states that so the two no longer disagree.

A worker ticket asked for spec amendments to land, and the worker wrote five bullets straight into specifications/04-chassis-modules.md, citing the ticket as the reason. The skill's rule is the owner-approval gate; the ticket's wording does not override it, so the skill needs the explicit clause.

A worker finished a ticket whose code made a VIEW-003 sentence false and reported the difference without drafting the amendment, which leaves the record wrong. The rule already names artifacts/specs-draft/; the skill should say a worker must draft there in the same run, not only report.

The worker found no record for the phone setup and then drafted an amendment to the error-surface record for the page banner; the skill's wording ("no record at all gets a new record") does not say which to choose when a neighbouring record covers the surface the change lands on. Making the choice explicit keeps the next worker from opening a duplicate record.

A worker followed the ticket's request to edit the spec records directly and wrote approval-gated amendments into specifications/, contrary to this skill. Make the precedence explicit so a ticket's wording does not override the draft rule.

A same-day amendment (VIEW-002, the hung-server text) still described the 5 s and 2 s clocks after the code had changed. The skill tells workers to check original sentences only, so earlier amendments go stale unnoticed.

Routing gap: a ticket agent appended a VIEW-045 amendment straight into specifications/09-viewer.md without this skill loading, though the skill says workers draft to artifacts/specs-draft/ instead. Widening the trigger to any spec edit gets the skill read before the write.

Agent asked Rich for a separate specification for the knowledge-layer design; Rich corrected it that the spec is already in the paper. The lookup belongs before any request for a spec, and the approval path is unchanged.
The skill already says the paper is the design record, but its trigger does not fire when someone is about to ask for a spec round. Add that trigger so the paper is read first.

The worker's first Write of the LAYER-028 amendment draft into artifacts/specs-draft/ was refused; the draft only went through after dispatch_link linked the file to code.graph.knowledge. The skill tells workers to draft there but says nothing about the link step.
